name: Material variants
summary: Swap the constitutive model (elastic, weakly-compressible fluid, snow plasticity) and study how each behaves and optimizes under the same control task. The most visually striking axis for the demo.

tasks.title: Elastic vs fluid vs snow under the same control task
tasks.note: Run the throw task with three constitutive models and compare how controllable each is. Fluids and snow have very different gradient behavior, and the visuals are the most demo-friendly thing in the project.
